title: NBAP: convert to ws_log system
description:
Use the ws_log system instead of custom debug routines. If Wireshark
isn't compiled for the Debug target, the compiler will optimize away all
these calls.

Replace calls of `nbap_debug()` (which was, ironically, `#define`d to be
`ws_warning()`) with `ws_debug()`.

The change uncovered some direct access to conversation elements that
have since changed API. Replace direct access to `key_ptr->addr1` with
call to `conversation_key_addr1()` and similar.

Initialize a pointer to `NULL` that the compiler claims may be used
uninitialized.

Ping #19519
